subject: Request: Senior Pricing Exception for Hosted API Pilot — >20% Discount
messages:
From: Eliza Park <eliza.park@novacare.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pilot — pricing ask and commitment details

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week. Novacare is excited to run a Q3 pilot of Redwood Hosted API for our clinical summarization pipeline. We can commit to a 3-month pilot (estimated 45M tokens total) and a product integration across 2 teams, with the goal to scale to 200M tokens/mo if evaluation goes well.

To make the economics work for our CFO and get the aprovado sign-off, we need a refreshed quote. Your standard published list is helpful, but given the pilot scale and the committed ramp, we are asking for a 30% reduction off list for the pilot period and a price cap on overage. We also need a short SOW and an assurance on data handling (SOC2 + dedicated logging).

Can you share what flexibility you have for a strategic pilot? If needed, Eliza + I can join a quick call with your pricing team today.

Thanks,
Eliza Park
Director, Integrations — Novacare Systems

Attachments: Usage_Forecast_2028_Q3.xlsx

From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — pricing ask and commitment details

Team — forwarding Novacare's ask. Short summary: 3-month pilot, 45M tokens committed in pilot, possible large-scale ramp to 200M tokens/mo, requesting 30% off list for pilot and price cap on overage. They require SOC2 confirmation and an SOW.

Why I'm escalating: the requested 30% is > our standard concession threshold; this is a net-new, strategic channel prospect (healthcare integrations) and they are sensitive to pilot economics. Requested approval: provide a pilot discount up to 30% with these guardrails:
- Pilot only (3 months) — discount applies only to pilot committed volume; standard pricing applies after pilot unless we schedule a renewal review.
- Cap overage at +10% of committed volume at the pilot price (to avoid surprise spikes).
- SOW to include redacted-data handling + SOC2 confirmation and audit log access.
- Signed deal desk memo and finance sign-off on revenue recognition.

Ben / Mina — can you weigh in on whether a 30% concession is acceptable vs. a capped 25% alternative? Lauren — need finance view on recognition, and Tessa — legal/SOW constraints?

Thanks,
Rafael

[Attachment: Novacare_HostedAPI_Pilot_Proposal_Q3.pdf]

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — pricing ask and commitment details

Rafael / team — quick take from sales: Novacare looks like a strong strategic reference in the clinical ISV space. If they convert, the post-pilot upside is high and helps our APAC expansion narrative. I support a concession but recommend we structure as: 25% off list for the pilot committed volume + a one-time implementation credit (applied as usage offset) to help their CFO. If they insist on 30%, request must go to Mina for final signoff.

Mina — are you available for a 1:1 to review the economic impact? I pushed the usage forecast into the HubSpot deal (link below).

Thanks,
Ben

Related: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/D-2028-0731-NOV

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — pricing ask and commitment details

Team — finance perspective: a 30% pilot discount is material but manageable if we secure the committed volume in writing and ensure revenue deferral is handled correctly. Conditions we need before approval:
- Signed MPA/SOW with explicit committed pilot volume and billing schedule.
- Prepayment or a minimum guarantee clause for the pilot (recommend 50% upfront of pilot committed spend).
- Clear definition of post-pilot conversion terms and a renew/terminate clause.

If we get those, I'm comfortable approving a 25% discount without exec escalation. For 30% we need Mina's signoff as it crosses our delegated concession threshold; also request a short memo on strategic rationale from Sales.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance — Revenue Operations

Attachments: SOW_Novacare_draft.docx

From: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot — pricing ask and commitment details — Exec approval decision

All — I reviewed the ask and supporting forecast. Novacare is high strategic value (channel + healthcare reference). I'm authorizing an executive exception up to 30% off list for the 3-month pilot under these firm conditions: 
1) 50% of pilot committed spend prepaid and non-refundable (applies to committed 45M tokens).
2) Discount only applies to committed pilot volume; any overage billed at pilot unit price up to 10% above committed volume.
3) Signed SOW and MPA in place prior to production access; legal to include SOC2 attestation and logging SLA.
4) Deal desk to record concession and new pricing tier in HubSpot.

Rafael / Ben — please communicate the structure to Eliza and get a signed DocuSign before provisioning. Finance and Legal will review the final SOW; I will sign the concession memo once the HubSpot record and DocuSign are attached.

Mina Haddad
VP, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference

--
